data.name: The Official Hollywood Sign Express Walking Tour in Los Angeles-Free Waters!
data.headline: For all ages! • 1 Hour • Up to 30 People
data.description:
#Celebrating the 100th Year Anniversary of the Hollywood Sign!			

##About					
We’ll take you to the front of the HOLLYWOOD SIGN! With tons of opportunities for ELITE Instagram photos, insider Hollywood History, and a local guide who actually works in Show Business, this hike brags some of the best views in LA. Snag a bird’s eye view of top film studios Disney, Warner Bros., Paramount, Dreamworks, the Hollywood Walk of fame, and more! 

Your Guide will tell you story after story that will make you forget you're actually walking up a hill.
data.cancellation_notes: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours in advance of the start date of the experience.
